title: tanacetum zahlbruckneri
intro: Tanacetum zahlbruckneri, commonly known as Mountain Tansy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tansy include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe the digestive system and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Tansy include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are known for their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
